liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments fell by {{cash_like.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_like@FY2025}}, taking cash liquidity to revenue down by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2025}}.

Debt due within one year rose by {{debt_due_1y.change@FY2025}} to {{debt_due_1y@FY2025}}, which cash and cash-like investments of {{cash_like@FY2025}} cover, so the near-term maturities do not depend on new funding.

Free cash flow after lease payments was {{fcf_after_leases@FY2024}} in FY2024, or {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt@FY2024}} of debt, a small fraction of the {{fcf@FY2024}} free cash flow reported before lease payments.
The TAV group's guarantee of part of the bank loan financing the initial Antalya concession payment no longer exists at year-end after the refinancing of the previous bank loan.

watch_items.text: Cash liquidity: cash liquidity to revenue fell by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2025}}, below the peer median of {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_median@FY2025}}.

Maturities: debt due within one year rose by {{debt_due_1y.change@FY2025}} to {{debt_due_1y@FY2025}}, against cash and cash-like investments of {{cash_like@FY2025}} that fell by {{cash_like.change@FY2025}}.

Cash flow after leases: free cash flow after lease payments was {{fcf_after_leases@FY2024}} in FY2024, only {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt@FY2024}} of debt, so lease payments absorb most of the cash the group generates.
Leverage: net leverage of {{net_leverage@FY2025}} is above the peer median of {{net_leverage.peer_median@FY2025}}, the weakest of the group ({{net_leverage.peer_rank@FY2025}}).
